articles.summary: NETGEAR Align makes AV intelligent and programmable. It's plug-and-play, manageable from anywhere, and open to third-party apps running securely alongside NETGEAR's. Align is also the answer to the top-requested feature since Engage launched: secure access from anywhere.
articles.title: NETGEAR unleashes the AV platform layer with launch of Align
